messages:
maria (PM): Reminder: customer wants tenant-prefetch + generator integrated. Need scope lock by EOD Fri. Goals: p99 <250ms for short completions, tenant isolation, canary + rollback.

aj (EngLead): Main cross-team work: runtime batching + prefix cache (tess), reserved burst GPUs + autoscale hooks (samir), and security checklist (olivia). Storage eviction schema may change.

tess (Runtime): Plan: namespaced prefetch shim + batching tuning. Can deliver a compatibility shim but we need a fallback model. Est: 0.5 FTE x3 sprints; will run regression evals for quant path.

samir (Infra): Requesting 8 reserved GPUs for burst/prewarm. Provisioning + tests ~2w. Will post SKU, cost, and autoscale playbook. Finance signoff required.

olivia (Security): KMS namespacing acceptable. Need log scrubbing, KMS tagging, rotation notes. I'll PR a short compliance checklist by Thu.

jamie (SRE): SLO/runbook: fallback to smaller model when queue_time >80ms or sustained queue >300ms. Alerts for 5m error spike. Rollback steps: disable prefetch toggle, route traffic to baseline pool.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: /schedule canary 1988-09-01 09:00 UTC for 48h. Reply :thumbsup: to confirm.

niko (PMM): Messaging: prefetch improves p95/p99 but may increase token usage; prepare customer guidance and pricing note.

aj (EngLead): Action recap: tess -> shim + evals; samir -> capacity + cost; olivia -> checklist PR; jamie -> SLO/runbook; maria -> finalize scope and run Fri 10:00 alignment.

maria (PM): Dropping minimal shim config below. Comment on incompatibilities.

```
prefetch:
  enabled: true
  mode: namespaced
  max_tokens: 200
  fallback: redwood-small-v1
  fallback_threshold_ms: 80
```
